title: 45m Stakeholder Sprint: Playmap & Facilitator Cheatsheet (Pre-QBR)
content:
Purpose:
This is a compact, repeatable 45-minute stakeholder sprint designed to run in the 30–60 day lead-up to a formal quarterly business review. The goal is to align on renewal posture, surface one or two tactical asks, and lock next-step owners so we reduce last-minute exec surprises in the QBR.

Audience and when to use it:
- Primary: CSM, Solutions lead, Customer success manager, Customer technical lead.
- Secondary: Account exec, Product manager (optional), SRE on-call (if there are active incidents).
- Use this when a customer is in the ‘at-risk’ to ‘watch’ band or when renewal probability is unclear and you need rapid alignment.

Meeting length and logistics:
- Total: 45 minutes
- Format: Video + shared doc (this playmap) + short live demo/dashboard share
- Required prework: CSM completes the 5-minute preflight (data snapshot section below) and shares the one-pager 24 hours prior.

Agenda (timeboxed):
- 0:00–03:00 — Quick purpose + roles (facilitator: CSM)
  - Facilitator line: “Goal for 45 mins: sync on renewal posture, confirm top risks, and agree three specific actions we own before the QBR.”
- 03:00–10:00 — Current-state snapshot (data owner: CSM)
  - Bring: 30-day usage trend, key error/latency incidents, support ticket heatmap, top 3 feature gaps mentioned by customer.
- 10:00–25:00 — Customer voice & friction mapping (facilitator runs Socratic loop)
  - Use prompt: “Tell us what’s changed since our last checkpoint. What’s working and what’s blocking adoption?”
  - Note the top 1–2 friction points and whether they are product, integration, or process.
- 25:00–35:00 — Renewal posture & ask framing (facilitator proposes a renewal hypothesis)
  - Renewal hypothesis script: “Based on the signals, our best estimate is [Green/Yellow/Red]. Recommended ask to move to [target posture]: [example: commit to feature beta, schedule technical deep-dive, extend pilot scope].”
- 35:00–43:00 — Decision ledger & owners (assign actions with SLA)
  - Capture: action, owner, due date (72 hours max for blockers), acceptance criteria.
- 43:00–45:00 — Close + confirm next sync (optional collaterals to prepare for QBR)

Facilitation script: quick phrases and fallbacks
- Kickoff: “We’re tight on time — focus on decisions not updates. If something needs follow-up, we’ll add it to the decision ledger.”
- Re-centering: “We’re here to reduce friction for renewal — what’s one concrete outcome we can commit to in the next week?”
- When conversation drifts into technical minutiae: “Great deep dive — let’s capture this and hand off to an engineering working session. For now, what’s the short-term mitigation?”
- If the customer pushes for a product promise: “We can commit to evaluation and prioritization, not shipping dates. Let’s define acceptance criteria and a named owner.”

Preflight data snapshot (CSM to prepare, deliver 24h prior) — 1 pager max
- Top-line renewal state: current term end, committed seats/units, current ARR footprint
- 30/90-day usage delta (top metric for the account)
- Active Sev incidents in last 90 days + status
- Top 3 open tickets/feature requests impacting renewal (title + link)
- Recent escalations and their outcomes
- Customer sentiment note (one sentence): e.g., “Net promoter: mixed — likes latency, unhappy about outage in Jan”

Signal guide (how to qualify green/yellow/red)
- Green: sustained usage growth >= 15% quarter-over-quarter, no sev incidents in 90 days, NPS >= +20 in last touchpoint, clear exec sponsorship
- Yellow: flat or slight decline (0–15%), one Sev or recurring ticket class, product gaps that require >2 weeks of engineering, unclear sponsor cadence
- Red: usage down >15%, multiple Sev incidents in 90 days, churn signals (contract reduction requests, exec silence)

Decision ledger template (one-line entries — copy/paste friendly)
- Action: [short description]
- Owner: [name]
- Due: [YYYY-MM-DD]
- Acceptance: [how we know it’s done]
- Escalation: [who to loop if missed]

Escalation ladder (when to escalate pre-QBR)
- If an action misses SLA (72h): loop AE and Solutions lead
- If risk remains after two sprint cycles: loop Customer Success Director and Product Manager
- If technical blocker with production impact: add SRE-on-call and provide incident CLI notes link

Deliverables to prepare for the formal QBR (if sprint indicates need)
- 1-page renewal summary (owner: CSM)
- Technical deep-dive slide (owner: Solutions engineer)
- Executive one-liner for GTM/AE (owner: AE)
- Priority backlog snapshot with expected timelines (owner: Product)

Email templates (condensed)
- Pre-sprint invite (CSM -> stakeholders): "Quick 45m to align on renewal posture and blockers before our QBR. Please review the 1-pager (attached) before the meeting. Goal: lock next-step owners."
- Post-sprint recap: "Thanks all — action items listed below. If you’re the owner, confirm by EOD (or reassign). We'll fold these into the QBR deck if needed."

Notes on common patterns and mitigation plays (tactical playbook)
- Low usage + exec interest: run a 2-week adoption blitz (product tour + integration support) with daily syncs and measurement. Owner: CSM + Solutions Eng.
- Technical regressions: schedule a 60–90 min SRE-led RCA and propose a customer-facing postmortem. Owner: SRE + Solutions Eng.
- Contract compression ask: propose a short-term extension with staged milestones tied to delivery (legal and AE involved). Owner: AE + CS Director.

How to use this doc in Drive:
- Duplicate this file for each account sprint and attach the 1-pager to the calendar invite.
- Keep the decision ledger at the top of the doc so it’s visible on mobile.
- Tag the final sprint doc with the customer name and the QBR month before archiving (use tag: account-<name>-qbr-YYYYMM).

Quick checklist (CSM) before running the sprint:
- [ ] Fill preflight snapshot and attach to invite (24h prior)
- [ ] Invite required stakeholders (CSM, AE, Solutions Eng, customer TL)
- [ ] Confirm dashboard permissions (viewer link)
- [ ] Prep one example customer quote to surface during friction mapping
- [ ] Open a decision ledger doc and share edit link

Appendix: compact metrics table (to paste into 1-pager) — single-line entries only
- MAU (30d): [number]
- Tokens/request avg latency: [value]
- Top error class: [brief]
- Open tickets >30d: [count]
- Renewal date: [YYYY-MM-DD]

Version notes:
- V0.1 (2025-02-10) — initial draft, Maya Chen
- V0.2 (2025-02-14) — added escalation ladder and email templates, feedback from Diego

Open questions / TODOs for the working group:
- Should we standardize the 72-hour SLA or make it configurable by tier? (product/CS ops discussion)
- Can we add an automated Slack workflow to create a decision ledger row from the meeting transcript? (eng feasibility)
- Request: AE wants a one-liner template for exec renewals — capture examples and add to appendix.

-- end of document --
